"""Verify fix for: LogisticRegressionCV(multi_class='multinomial') used OvR
probs when scoring with probabilistic scorers (neg_log_loss)."""
import numpy as np
from sklearn import linear_model
from sklearn.linear_model.logistic import _log_reg_scoring_path
from sklearn.metrics.scorer import check_scoring
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

np.random.seed(1234)
X = np.random.random(size=(200, 5))
y = np.random.choice(['a', 'b', 'c'], size=200)

# 1) _log_reg_scoring_path with multinomial must produce softmax-consistent
#    scores: compare against a manually fitted multinomial LogisticRegression
#    scored with neg_log_loss on the same fold.
train, test = list(range(150)), list(range(150, 200))
coefs, Cs, scores, n_iter = _log_reg_scoring_path(
    X, y, train, test, scoring='neg_log_loss', fit_intercept=False,
    multi_class='multinomial', solver='lbfgs')

lr = linear_model.LogisticRegression(fit_intercept=False, multi_class='multinomial',
                                     solver='lbfgs', C=Cs[-1])
lr.fit(X[train], y[train])
manual = check_scoring(lr, 'neg_log_loss')(lr, X[test], y[test])
print("scores (last C) =", scores[-1], " manual multinomial =", manual)
assert np.isclose(scores[-1], manual), (scores[-1], manual)

# 2) End-to-end: CV scores with multinomial must differ from OvR scores
#    (before the fix they were computed with OvR probs -> identical values).
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3)
cv = list(skf.split(X, y))
clf_mn = linear_model.LogisticRegressionCV(
    Cs=np.array([1.0]), cv=cv, scoring='neg_log_loss',
    multi_class='multinomial', solver='lbfgs').fit(X, y)
clf_ovr = linear_model.LogisticRegressionCV(
    Cs=np.array([1.0]), cv=cv, scoring='neg_log_loss',
    multi_class='ovr', solver='lbfgs').fit(X, y)
print("multinomial CV score:", clf_mn.scores_['a'].ravel())
print("ovr        CV score:", clf_ovr.scores_['a'].ravel())
assert not np.allclose(clf_mn.scores_['a'], clf_ovr.scores_['a']), \
    "multinomial scores identical to ovr -> bug still present"

# 3) predict_proba of the fitted multinomial CV estimator must be softmax
proba = clf_mn.predict_proba(X[:5])
assert np.allclose(proba.sum(axis=1), 1.0)
print("proba row sums ok:", proba.sum(axis=1))
print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
